title: Permian Resources Announces Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results and Updated Full Year Guidance
summary: MIDLAND, Texas – Permian Resources Corporation (“Permian Resources” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PR) today announced its third quarter 2026 financial and operational results and revised 2026 guidance.
